messages:
maria.sales: Quick sync: onboarding PacketSafe for POC tomorrow. They need Dedicated endpoint but their security team only allows three fixed outbound IPs. Can we outline the minimal POC network plan and any costs?

ton y.solutions: we can do a temporary NAT with three IPs for the pool. for POC we usually do 2 ips but 3 is fine. we'll also give them a curl test and a short expiry window.

devon.eng: network options: 1) Dedicated pool NAT with reserved static IPs (recommended). 2) Customer reverse-proxy to our ingress (if they cannot open egress) 3) VPC peering/private deployment (longer runway). For POC go with option 1.

maria.sales: Do we support IP rotation mid-POC if their compliance team demands it?

devon.eng: we can rotate but need coordination. better if they allow the three IPs for the POC window. automatic rotation requires them to support dynamic allowlist updates. :warning:

maria.sales: Any fees?

ton y.solutions: there's a small monthly IP surcharge and a setup fee for static egress. sales-ops can waive the setup fee for a paid POC. I'll loop in @alex.

maria.sales: mTLS? customer prefers mutual TLS to the endpoint. Supported?

devon.eng: mTLS available for Private deployments out of the box. For Dedicated we can enable a client cert check at the edge but it adds setup time (~48h) and they must supply certs.

sre-bot: Created ticket INF-2042 for PacketSafe POC. owner=devon.eng eta=2026-06-11

maria.sales: Great. I'll provide their expected RPS and token budget in the ticket. Also please include sample curl commands we can hand to the customer.

ton y.solutions: sample checks: 
```
# verify egress IP from bastion
curl -s https://ifconfig.co

# basic endpoint test (replace with NAT IP in the firewall)
curl -X POST https://dedicated.example.net/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <POC_KEY>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"input":"ping"}'
```

maria.sales: thanks, will update customers. :thumbsup:
